correctness.rationale: The image is a local quotient with residue field k and a one-dimensional nilpotent ideal kz. This line cannot lie in the square of the ambient maximal ideal because the retraction kills that square and fixes z. In odd characteristic the degree-two part of z^2 forces a unique nonzero tangent coefficient. In the decomposition z=x_i u+b, the coefficient of x_i in the square gives 2ub=0, so b=0 since u is a unit. Normalize the pivot and use e(z)=z to get v_i=1. The substitution x_i to x_i u has an explicit inverse x_i to x_i u^(-1), fixing all other generators. Thus the nonlinear tail does not obstruct conjugacy. Every automorphism has monomial tangent action, under which the number s (not the labeled support) of off-pivot nonzero coefficients is invariant, and permutations and scalings realize every matching support size. Composition either agrees only for the identical map at the same pivot, or, at distinct pivots, vanishes on the maximal ideal in both orders precisely when the two cross coefficients vanish. Each allowed pivot contributes q^(B-1) neighbors, which gives the degree spectrum, diagonal-adjusted pair count and clique bound. Independent substitution checks at (d,q)=(2,3) and (3,3) give 18 and 729 vertices, and 36 and 40095 ordered commuting pairs, respectively.
residual_risks: Independent replay is bounded and over the prime field only; the algebraic argument applies to every odd finite field.

originality.rationale: The exact-algebra automorphism description is previously covered; so are the general image-retract framework and the characteristic-two analogue. The distinct surviving finding is the classification of composition-idempotent maps with two-dimensional image over an odd finite field, with full conjugacy detected by ordinary graph degree and explicit orbit and degree enumerators. None of the inspected results classifies those maps together with this commutation criterion, and the known automorphism description does not alone give either.
residual_risks: This is best-of-knowledge, not a priority proof; an equivalent odd-characteristic splitting classification under other terminology could have been missed.

value.rationale: Dimension two is the first nontrivial image dimension and need not be confused with tangent rank. A researcher gets the actual list of splittings and the class of any map from a directly observable graph statistic, without testing conjugacy in a large automorphism group. The change from a single characteristic-two class to a full support-size spectrum in odd characteristic and its exact graph multiplicities are useful for these natural finite algebras; the reworked automorphism ingredient alone would not qualify.
residual_risks: No classification at larger image dimension is supplied or needed for this value judgment.
